validation.type: Independent synthetic closed-run evidence tests; no production rendering

contracts: Final frozen browser fixture bytes determine merged fixtureSha256.
Every final row equals the original donor row using typed canonical JSON, including every field, not a selected subset.
Final denominator equals full donor union; no casefold duplicates or missing/extra cases.
Donor oracle manifest and identity are closed-run hashed artifacts and identities agree across donors.
Donor fixture bytes match both its run artifact hash and oracle fixtureSha256.
Exactly one corresponding bulk_capture command and its hashed result are closed SUCCESS/exit0. Overall FAILED donor status is preserved, not relabeled.
All copied PNG/SVG/snapshot/error bytes match closed Run.artifacts hashes and are rehashed after copying.
No image transformation; output directory must not exist.
Reuse provenance records donor run/hash/status, manifest/identity/fixture hashes, exact source command, and every copied file hash.
cli: python tools/merge_bulk_oracles.py --fixtures FINAL_BROWSER_CASES --donor RUN_JSON ORACLE_DIR BROWSER_FIXTURE_JSON [--donor ...] --out NEW_DIR

preservedAttempts.reason: Tool assumed excluded manifest rows contained kind/expect; fixed source records only id/status. Complete frozen row remains strictly bound.
Prefix glob incorrectly treated dotted IDs elk.box etc as files of case elk; exact suffix lookup fixed and independent dotted-ID test added.
